US Democrats' House control chances and potential stock market impact

Democrats have a 93% chance of regaining control of the House of Representatives, according to one analysis. This potential shift in power could have implications for the stock market. Separately, Democrats are reportedly seeing new opportunities to win in red states, though a $400 million spending advantage for the Republican party could pose a challenge to these efforts.
